modules.label: Modular Oscillator
modules.summary: Sine, triangle, saw and pulse at once, free of aliasing, with the pulse's width, exponential and linear FM, and hard sync.

modules.label: Complex Oscillator
modules.summary: Two oscillators, one modulating the other's frequency through zero and its phase, then folded; the modulator has an output of its own.

modules.label: Morph Oscillator
modules.summary: One wave that morphs smoothly from sine to triangle to saw to square, the morph moved as fast as audio.

modules.label: Modular LFO
modules.summary: A slow wave for modulation: sine, triangle, ramp and pulse at once, around zero or above it, free or locked to the tempo (eight bars to a thirty-second, triplets and dotted), restarted by a gate or read along a Phase input.

modules.label: Modular ADSR
modules.summary: Attack, decay, sustain and release for each voice while its gate is held, started again by a trigger, the same upside down, and a pulse at its end.

modules.label: Slope Function
modules.summary: A rise and a fall at each trigger, or round and round as an LFO, with a curve, and pulses at the end of the rise and of the fall.

modules.label: Modular VCA
modules.summary: How loud each voice is, set by a control voltage, on a straight or an exponential curve.

modules.label: Modular Multimode Filter
modules.summary: A state-variable filter that stays stable at any setting, its low-pass, band-pass, high-pass and notch at once, with drive.

modules.label: Dual Multimode Filter
modules.summary: Two state-variable filters, the second tuned apart from the first, one after the other or side by side.

modules.label: Modular Mixer
modules.summary: Four inputs, audio or control, each with its own level, which can turn it upside down, mixed for each voice.

modules.label: Attenuverter
modules.summary: A signal made larger, smaller or upside down, and moved up or down: for audio or modulation.

modules.label: Constant Voltage
modules.summary: A steady voltage, set exactly: to tune, to bias, or to control.

modules.label: Noise and Random
modules.summary: White and pink noise, and a random voltage that wanders smoothly, the same each time from its seed.

modules.label: Stepped Random
modules.summary: A new random voltage at each clock or at its own rate, by a chance, the same each time from its seed, gliding to it or jumping.

modules.label: Sample and Hold
modules.summary: A voltage taken at each clock and held, or followed while the clock is high and held when it falls.

modules.label: Slew Limiter
modules.summary: How fast a voltage may rise and fall, each set apart: for glide, and to smooth modulation.

modules.label: Pitch Quantizer
modules.summary: A pitch moved to the nearest note of a scale: one of fourteen, the song's, notes of your own, or the notes held, from a root, transposed; and a pulse each time the note changes.

modules.label: Modular Clock
modules.summary: A clock with swing, at its own tempo or the song's, with its place in each pulse and a gate while it runs.

modules.label: Clock Divider
modules.summary: A clock divided by two, three, four and eight at once, and by any number up to 64 at its main output.

modules.label: Voltage Sequencer
modules.summary: Eight steps of pitch, a clock stepping them and a gate at each, played to a length of steps you set.

modules.label: Euclidean Gates
modules.summary: A number of hits spread as evenly as they go over a number of steps, turned round to start elsewhere, and an accent on the hits that fall every so many steps.

modules.label: Gate Logic
modules.summary: Two gates or clocks compared: AND, OR, XOR, NOT, NAND, NOR and XNOR at once.

modules.label: Voltage Comparator
modules.summary: A gate while a voltage is above a threshold, a margin keeping it from chattering, and a pulse as it rises past and as it falls.

modules.label: Sequential Switch
modules.summary: One of four signals let through, chosen by a knob or the next at each clock.

modules.label: Router
modules.summary: One input sent to one of four outputs, chosen by a knob or stepped by a clock, faded across in 5 ms.

modules.label: Mid/Side
modules.summary: Left and right as mid and side and back: the side's width, the mid's level, and mid and side to mix in.

modules.label: Crossover
modules.summary: Three bands, low, mid and high, at two splits (Linkwitz-Riley, 24 dB an octave), adding up to what came in.

modules.label: Stereo Mixer
modules.summary: Eight inputs, each with a level and a pan, to a stereo pair and a mono sum.

modules.label: Value Readout
modules.summary: Four signals' values as numbers, a pitch as its note and frequency, passed through unchanged.

modules.label: XY Scope
modules.summary: Two signals drawn against each other: a Lissajous figure of two oscillators, a stereo pair's width.

modules.label: Spectrum
modules.summary: The frequencies in a signal as it plays, passed through unchanged.

modules.label: Label
modules.summary: A note on the patch, as large as you write it: no jacks, no sound.

modules.label: Voltage Crossfader
modules.summary: Two signals faded into each other for each voice, in a straight line or at equal power.

modules.label: Voltage Panner
modules.summary: A signal, or each voice, panned into stereo, as loud wherever it is.

modules.label: Wavefolder
modules.summary: A wave folded back on itself again and again, for bright overtones, off center by its symmetry, the fold moved as fast as audio.

modules.label: Ring Modulator
modules.summary: Two signals multiplied: a ring modulator's sound, and amplitude modulation.

modules.label: Voltage Saturator
modules.summary: Smooth saturation, driven harder or softer, lopsided by its bias, mixed with what came in.

modules.label: Shaper
modules.summary: Chebyshev harmonics of an order, a diode's lopsided curve, a hard clip, fewer bits, or steps of a voltage.

modules.label: Pitch Utility
modules.summary: A pitch moved by semitones, octaves, a ratio of whole numbers and cents.

modules.label: Modular Delay
modules.summary: An echo up to two seconds long, free or a share of the beat, its time moved as fast as audio, its feedback kept in bounds.

modules.label: Chorus / Flanger
modules.summary: Three swept taps a third of a cycle apart (chorus) or one with feedback (flanger), spread in stereo.

modules.label: Phaser
modules.summary: Two to twelve swept all-pass stages with feedback, mixed with what came in.

modules.label: Frequency Shifter
modules.summary: Every frequency moved by the same number of hertz, up and down at once (a Hilbert pair).

modules.label: Pitch Shifter
modules.summary: A pitch moved by semitones and cents, or by 1 V an octave, through two crossfading taps.

modules.label: Modal Resonator
modules.summary: Four ringing modes at a pitch, struck by a gate or set ringing by audio, with structure, decay and brightness.

modules.label: Grain Texture
modules.summary: What comes in, cut into grains, four overlapping for each voice, with their size, density, position and pitch, and a freeze.

modules.label: Spectral Bank
modules.summary: Eight resonant bands side by side, each with its own level, all moved together in frequency.

modules.label: Envelope Follower
modules.summary: How loud a signal is, as a voltage that follows it with its own attack and release, and a gate while it is above a threshold.

modules.label: Voltage Rectifier
modules.summary: A signal's negative half turned up or cut off, the signal upside down, and the lower and the higher of it and a second.

modules.label: Buffered Multiple
modules.summary: One signal at four outputs, unchanged, its voices kept.

modules.label: Probability Gates
modules.summary: Each trigger sent to one output or the other by a chance, the same each time from its seed.

modules.label: Trigger Delay
modules.summary: A trigger, a while later, as a pulse as long as you set.

modules.label: Transport
modules.summary: The song's place as signals: running, ramps over each beat, each bar and a length of bars, a pulse at each beat and bar, and the tempo.

modules.label: Phasor
modules.summary: A ramp from 0 to 10 V, free or locked to the tempo, to drive oscillators, LFOs and sequencers in step.

modules.label: Step Sequencer
modules.summary: Sixteen steps of pitch, each resting, playing or tied on, with accent and chance; forward, backward, ping-pong or random, clocked or read along a Phase input.

modules.label: Trigger Sequencer
modules.summary: Four tracks of sixteen steps, each off, on or accented, with a chance for each track.

modules.label: Clock Ratio
modules.summary: An incoming clock multiplied and divided by whole numbers, its pulses spread evenly.

modules.label: Clock Quantizer
modules.summary: Holds each gate until the next clock, then lets it through: as a pulse, or for as long as it is held.

modules.label: Math
modules.summary: Two signals added, subtracted, multiplied, divided, compared, clipped or averaged, and gates for which is above.

modules.label: Latch
modules.summary: A flip-flop: set, reset or toggled by gates, or taking its data input at each clock.

modules.label: Counter
modules.summary: Counts clocks up and down to a length, as a voltage and a pitch, with a carry pulse each time it wraps.

modules.label: Ratchet
modules.summary: Repeats a gate: a number of pulses at an interval, or for as long as it is held.

modules.label: Shift Register
modules.summary: Eight stages a clock moves a value along: its data input's, or its own last stage, changed by chance (a looping random sequence), with a weighted sum.

modules.label: Note to CV
modules.summary: The rack's notes as signals for each voice: pitch at 1 V an octave, gate, velocity, pressure, bend and slide.

modules.label: Voice Info
modules.summary: Each voice's number and its place across the voices (to spread a unison's tuning or pan), the keys held, the lowest and highest of them, and a gate while any is.

modules.label: Signal Monitor
modules.summary: A signal passed through unchanged, its value on the meters and there for agents to read.

modules.label: Coupled Low-pass Gate
modules.summary: Loudness and a low-pass filter opened and closed together, with an attack and a decay of their own, struck by a gate or played by a control; or the amplifier alone, or the filter alone.

modules.label: Character Oscillator
modules.summary: Every analog oscillator the app has, as Vintergatan plays them: the pure one, and Titan 303's, Shy One's, June Bloom's, Promise Bloom's, Mini Moonbeam's and the Two-Filter Mono's own cores.

modules.label: Character Filter
modules.summary: Every filter the app has, as Vintergatan plays them: the transistor and diode ladders, Sallen-Key, OTA, state variable, the pure filter, the hardware models' own filters, and comb, phaser, formant, ring and reverb.

modules.label: Wavetable Oscillator
modules.summary: Vintergatan's wavetable oscillator: the factory tables, or one made of the audio in its slot, read by position, band-limited, through its twenty warps, a second warp and a spectral morph; the FM, AM and ring warps take the Other input.

modules.label: Sample Oscillator
modules.summary: Vintergatan's sample, granular and spectral oscillators on the audio in its slot: played from its start at each gate, once, looped, back and forth, reversed or held; as grains scattered about a position; or taken apart into its partials and put together again, its speed apart from its pitch, through a spectral morph.

modules.label: Multisample Oscillator
modules.summary: Vintergatan's multisample oscillator: a sample library (SFZ, DecentSampler, SoundFont or Sampler instrument) across the keys, each gate playing the zone its pitch and velocity fall in from that zone's own root.

modules.label: Subpatch
modules.summary: Modules and cables of its own, as one module: its jacks are the Subpatch Inputs and Outputs inside it. Cmd/Ctrl+G makes one of the modules selected; double-click it to open it.

modules.label: Subpatch Input
modules.summary: A jack of the subpatch it is in: what is patched into that jack from outside comes out of it here.

modules.label: Subpatch Output
modules.summary: A jack of the subpatch it is in: what is patched into it here goes out of that jack.
